title: OpenBSE Input Schema
description: Complete schema definition for OpenBSE YAML input files. Analogous to the EnergyPlus IDD — defines every class, field, type, allowed values, units, and defaults. Use this to build editors, validators, and programmatic interfaces.

weather_files.description: Weather file paths (EPW or CSV). Supports multiple for multi-year runs.

performance_curves.description: Reusable performance curves for equipment. Referenced by name from components.

air_loops.description: Air-side HVAC loops (AHUs, RTUs, FCUs, DOAS units).

plant_loops.description: Water-side plant loops (hot water, chilled water).

zone_groups.description: Named groups of zones for referencing in thermostats and loads.

thermostats.description: Zone thermostat definitions with heating/cooling setpoints.

controls.description: Setpoint controllers for coils and plant loops.

parametrics.description: Optional parametric run definitions for batch analysis.

schedules.description: Named schedule profiles for time-varying inputs.

constructions.description: Opaque constructions defined as material layers (outside to inside).

window_constructions.description: Window constructions defined by U-factor and SHGC.

simple_constructions.description: Simplified constructions defined by U-factor and lumped thermal capacity.

equipment.description: Internal equipment gain definitions assignable to zones.

ventilation.description: Mechanical ventilation definitions assignable to zones.

exhaust_fans.description: Exhaust fan definitions assignable to zones.

outdoor_air.description: Outdoor air requirement definitions for minimum ventilation sizing.

ideal_loads.description: Ideal loads air systems for zone load testing without real HVAC.

summary_report.description: Whether to generate the standard summary report.

timesteps_per_hour.description: Number of simulation timesteps per hour.

terrain.description: Site terrain for wind profile calculations.

shading_calculation.description: Shading mode. 'detailed' enables geometric shadow calculations.

infiltration_interaction.description: How infiltration combines with exhaust. 'ashrae_combined' uses sqrt(infil^2 + exhaust^2).

run_parametrics.description: Whether to execute parametric runs defined in the parametrics section. Set to false to run the base model only without deleting parametric definitions.

AirflowNetworkConfig.description: Multizone pressure network airflow configuration. When enabled, auto-generates a pressure network from building geometry and solves for pressure-driven infiltration using Newton-Raphson.

cp_model.description: Wind pressure coefficient model: a named correlation, or a user Cp table interpolated from the EPW wind direction (YAML tag form: `cp_model: !table`).

wind_angles.description: Wind directions [deg from north], ascending, within [0, 360).

azimuth.description: Facade outward normal azimuth [deg from north].

cp.description: Cp value per entry in wind_angles.

default_crack_exponent.description: Flow exponent n for auto-generated cracks.

wall_leakage_per_area.description: Crack leakage per unit wall area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

window_leakage_per_area.description: Crack leakage per unit window area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

door_leakage_per_perimeter.description: Crack leakage per unit door perimeter [kg/s/m/Pa^n].

interzone_leakage_per_area.description: Interzone crack leakage per unit area [kg/s/m2/Pa^n].

wall_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for exterior walls. Overrides wall_leakage_per_area.

window_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for windows. Overrides window_leakage_per_area.

interzone_leakage_class.description: ASHRAE leakage class for interzone surfaces. Overrides interzone_leakage_per_area.

LeakageClass.description: ASHRAE construction leakage class (ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch. 16 Table 1): a=tight, b=average, c=leaky, d=very leaky.

SurfaceAirflowOverride.description: Per-surface overrides for the airflow network auto-generation.

large_opening.description: Treat surface as a large opening (door, operable window).

discharge_coefficient.description: Override discharge coefficient Cd for large opening.

opening_fraction.description: Opening area as fraction of surface area.

opening_schedule.description: Schedule name modulating the opening fraction each timestep [0-1]. 0 closes the opening.

DesignDay.description: Design day definition for autosizing calculations.

AutosizeOrNumber.description: Either a numeric value or the string 'autosize' to let the engine calculate.

CurveType.description: Mathematical form of the performance curve.

PerformanceCurve.description: Reusable performance curve. Modifies rated equipment performance as a function of operating conditions.

name.description: Unique curve name for referencing from components.

coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients. Count depends on curve_type: linear=2, quadratic=3, cubic=4, biquadratic=6.

AirLoopSystemType.description: HVAC system type hint. Usually auto-detected from equipment and controls. Descriptive aliases are accepted: variable_air_volume (=vav), dedicated_outdoor_air (=doas), fan_coil_unit (=fcu), packaged_terminal (=ptac), packaged_terminal_heat_pump (=pthp), packaged_single_zone (=psz_ac).

CyclingMethod.description: Capacity control method. on_off = cycling compressor; proportional = modulating output.

EconomizerType.description: Economizer control strategy for free cooling. differential_enthalpy: OA enthalpy < return enthalpy. fixed_enthalpy: OA enthalpy < high_limit_enthalpy. enthalpy_with_high_limit: differential enthalpy AND OA temp < high_limit.

high_limit.description: High limit shutoff temperature [C] (for fixed_dry_bulb and enthalpy_with_high_limit).

high_limit_enthalpy.description: High limit shutoff enthalpy [J/kg] (for fixed_enthalpy and enthalpy_with_high_limit). Default: 65200 J/kg (~28 BTU/lb, ASHRAE 90.1).

AirLoopControls.description: Control parameters for an air loop.

design_zone_flow.description: Design air flow rate per zone [kg/s]. Use 'autosize' for auto-calculation.

minimum_damper_position.description: Minimum outdoor air damper position [0-1]. Set to 1.0 for DOAS.

impeller_efficiency.description: Impeller (fan blade) efficiency [0-1]. Total efficiency = motor * impeller.

motor_in_airstream_fraction.description: Fraction of motor waste heat entering the airstream [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

efficiency.description: Heating efficiency [0-1]. 1.0 for electric, <1.0 for gas. Ignored for hot_water source (boiler handles efficiency).

CoolingCoil.description: Cooling coil component (DX or chilled water).

capacity.description: Rated total cooling capacity [W] at ARI conditions.

cap_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for capacity f(T_wb, T_outdoor).

eir_ft_curve.description: Name of a top-level performance curve for EIR f(T_wb, T_outdoor).

HeatRecovery.description: Air-to-air heat recovery component (energy recovery ventilator).

source.description: Heat recovery device type. Wheels transfer both sensible and latent; plates are sensible-only.

exhaust_flow_ratio.description: Exhaust-to-supply mass flow ratio [0-1]. Recovery is limited by the exhaust stream when it carries less flow than supply (typical with building pressurization).

Equipment.description: An air-side equipment component. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

ZoneConnection.description: Zone served by an air loop.

terminal.description: Optional terminal unit name (for VAV boxes).

AirLoop.description: Air-side HVAC loop. Equipment items are connected sequentially (air flows through them in order).

system_type.description: Optional system type hint. Auto-detected if omitted: VAV fan -> vav, damper=1.0 -> doas, default -> psz_ac. Use 'fcu' explicitly for fan coil units.

min_vav_fraction.description: Minimum VAV box flow fraction [0-1]. Only used for VAV systems.

availability_schedule.description: Schedule name. When schedule value is 0, system is OFF.

equipment.description: Supply-side equipment in air flow order.

zone_terminals.description: Zone terminal connections served by this air loop. (Alias: 'zones' is accepted for backward compatibility.)

Chiller.description: Electric chiller with COP and optional condenser water loop connection.

design_chw_flow.description: Design chilled water flow rate [m3/s]. Auto-calculated if 0.

condenser_plant_loop.description: Name of the condenser water plant loop. Required for water_cooled chillers.

capft.description: Capacity-f(T) biquadratic curve. x = leaving CHW temp, y = entering condenser temp.

PumpRole.description: Pump role in the plant loop. 'single' = standalone pump, 'primary' = constant flow through boiler/chiller, 'secondary' = variable flow distribution pump, 'headered' = staged pump bank.

PumpControlStrategy.description: Pump control strategy. 'demand' = flow varies with load, 'continuous' = constant speed when plant is active, 'staged' = OFF unless staged on by plant controller.

design_head.description: Design pump head [Pa]. Default ~60 ft H2O.

impeller_efficiency.description: Impeller/hydraulic efficiency [0-1]. Total efficiency = motor_efficiency * impeller_efficiency.

num_pumps.description: Number of pumps in headered configuration. Each pump's flow = total / num_pumps.

power_curve.description: Part-load power curve coefficients [c1, c2, c3, c4]. power_frac = c1 + c2*PLR + c3*PLR^2 + c4*PLR^3. Default: [0, 0, 0, 1] (affinity laws).

CoolingTower.description: Cooling tower for condenser water heat rejection. Single/two/variable-speed with effectiveness-NTU model and polynomial fan power curve.

design_water_flow.description: Design water flow rate [m3/s]. Use 'autosize' to size from condenser demand.

fan_power_curve.description: Fan power ratio curve [C1..C5]: PLF = C1 + C2*PLR + C3*PLR^2 + C4*PLR^3 + C5*PLR^4. Default: E+ variable-speed tower curve [0.0058, 0.0740, -0.2180, 0.8517, 0.2866].

HeatExchanger.description: Water-to-water plate-and-frame heat exchanger for inter-loop connections. Placed on the demand loop, draws from the source loop. Supports always-on (general inter-loop HX) or economizer mode (waterside economizer).

source_loop.description: Name of the source plant loop this HX draws from / rejects to.

design_flow_rate.description: Design flow rate on the demand side [m3/s].

control_mode.description: Control mode. 'always_on' for general inter-loop connection, 'economizer' activates only when source temperature enables free cooling.

economizer_threshold.description: For economizer mode: activate when T_source < T_demand_in + threshold [C].

CurveInput.description: Performance curve coefficients (quadratic, biquadratic, or cubic).

coefficients.description: Curve coefficients. Length determines type: 3 = quadratic, 6 = biquadratic, 4 = cubic.

PlantEquipment.description: Plant-side equipment. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

PlantLoop.description: Water-side plant loop (hot water or chilled water).

ZoneGroup.description: Named group of zones for referencing in thermostats and load definitions.

Thermostat.description: Zone thermostat with heating/cooling setpoints. Zones can reference zone group names.

zones.description: Zone names or zone group names.

SetpointControl.description: Fixed setpoint controller on a coil or component.

PlantLoopSetpointControl.description: Fixed setpoint controller on a plant loop.

Control.description: A control definition. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

ParametricRun.description: A single parametric run configuration. Override component parameters, swap weather files, or include template YAML sections.

name.description: Unique name for this run. Used in output filenames.

weather_file.description: Override weather file for this run (EPW path, relative to input file).

overrides.description: Scalar parameter overrides as 'ComponentName.field_name': value pairs. The component name must match a named object in the model (zone, thermostat, material, fan, coil, boiler, chiller, etc.). The field name must be a numeric field on that component (e.g., efficiency, cop, capacity, heating_setpoint).

include.description: Section replacements from external YAML files (Level 2 — not yet implemented).

SectionOverride.description: Replace top-level model sections with content from an external YAML file. Not yet implemented — scaffolding only.

file.description: Path to partial YAML file (relative to input file).

SweepInput.description: Sweep definition — automatically generate runs by varying a single parameter across a list of values or a numeric range.

values.description: Explicit list of values to sweep through. Can be combined with 'range' (explicit values come first, then range-generated values).

range.description: Generate values from min to max with a fixed step. Can be combined with 'values'.

SweepRange.description: Numeric range for sweep generation: produces values from min to max (inclusive) with the given step size.

Parametrics.description: Parametric analysis configuration. Define explicit runs with overrides, auto-generate runs from sweeps, or both. When both are present, explicit runs execute first, followed by expanded sweep runs.

runs.description: Explicit named runs with per-run overrides.

sweeps.description: Sweep definitions that auto-generate runs by varying parameters.

cross_product.description: If true, sweeps generate a Cartesian product of all parameter values (N1 x N2 x ... runs). If false (default), sweeps are zipped element-wise (all must have the same number of values).

Schedule.description: Named schedule with hourly fractional values for each day type.

weekday.description: Hourly fractional values for weekdays (Mon-Fri), hours 0-23.

weekend.description: Hourly fractional values for weekends (fallback for Sat and Sun if not specified).

thermal_absorptance.description: Hemispherical emissivity for longwave radiation exchange. For layered constructions, the outside material value is used for exterior LW radiation and the inside material value for interior LW radiation.

Construction.description: Opaque construction as ordered material layers (outside to inside).

WindowConstruction.description: Window construction defined by overall thermal and solar properties.

solar_absorptance.description: Glass solar absorptance [0-1]. Estimated from SHGC if omitted.

glass_emissivity.description: Glass hemispherical emissivity for interior and exterior longwave radiation exchange. Defaults to 0.84 (uncoated soda-lime glass). Use lower values for low-e coatings.

SimpleConstruction.description: Simplified construction using overall U-factor and lumped thermal capacity.

BoundaryCondition.description: Boundary condition: outdoor, ground, adiabatic, or adjacent zone name.

Surface.description: Building surface (wall, floor, roof, or window).

area.description: Surface area [m2]. Auto-calculated from vertices if 0.

azimuth.description: Outward normal azimuth [degrees from north, clockwise].

volume.description: Zone air volume [m3]. Auto-calculated from surfaces if 0.

floor_area.description: Zone floor area [m2]. Auto-calculated from floor surfaces if 0.

conditioned.description: Whether the zone is conditioned by HVAC.

max_relative_humidity.description: Maximum relative humidity setpoint [%] (e.g. 60). HVAC switches to dehumidification cooling when zone RH exceeds this.

min_relative_humidity.description: Minimum relative humidity setpoint [%] (e.g. 30). Humidifier activates when zone RH falls below this.

duct_leakage.description: Duct leakage to an unconditioned space. With the airflow network enabled, adds a pressure-driving flow path carrying leaked duct air from this zone to the zone containing the ducts.

ambient_zone.description: Zone containing the ducts (typically unconditioned: attic, crawlspace).

supply_leakage_fraction.description: Supply duct leakage as a fraction of supply flow.

return_leakage_fraction.description: Return duct leakage as a fraction of supply flow.

People.description: Occupancy definition assignable to one or more zones.

sensible_gain_per_person.description: Sensible heat gain per person [W/person]. Alternative to activity_level * sensible_fraction. Overrides activity_level when specified.

latent_gain_per_person.description: Latent heat gain per person [W/person]. Alternative to activity_level * (1 - sensible_fraction). Overrides activity_level when specified.

radiant_fraction.description: Fraction of heat gain that is radiant [0-1].

Lights.description: Lighting definition assignable to one or more zones.

return_air_fraction.description: Fraction of heat to return air plenum [0-1].

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting. Enables per-submeter output variables (e.g., submeter:Decorative:lighting).

lost_fraction.description: Fraction of heat that does not enter the zone [0-1]. Example: elevator with lost_fraction=0.95 means only 5% of heat enters the zone.

latent_fraction.description: Fraction of equipment heat that is latent (moisture-generating) [0-1]. Applied to non-lost portion: latent = power × (1 - lost_fraction) × latent_fraction. Examples: kitchen equipment, laundry.

submeter.description: Submeter label for end-use energy reporting.

Infiltration.description: Infiltration definition using EnergyPlus wind/temperature coefficient model.

flow_per_floor_area.description: Flow per floor area [m3/s per m2].

flow_per_exterior_wall_area.description: Flow per exterior wall area [m3/s per m2].

constant_coefficient.description: Coefficient A in F = design * (A + B*dT + C*wind + D*wind^2).

VentilationCombiningMethod.description: How multiple ventilation sources are combined.

outdoor_temp_must_be_lower.description: Only ventilate when outdoor is cooler than indoor.

OaMethod.description: Method for combining per-person and per-area outdoor air rates. 'sum' adds both contributions; 'maximum' takes the larger of the two.

OutdoorAir.description: Outdoor air requirement definition for minimum ventilation sizing.

per_area.description: OA per floor area [m3/s per m2].

oa_method.description: Method for combining per-person and per-area rates. Default: 'sum'.

IdealLoads.description: Ideal loads air system for zone load testing without real HVAC.

Aggregation.description: How values are aggregated within each reporting period.

variables.description:
Variable specs to include in output. Format: `category:variable` (all entities) or `category:variable:name_filter` (specific entity or glob with `*`).

Examples: `zone:temperature`, `zone:temperature:living_unit1`, `surface:transmitted_solar:Window*`, `building:fan_electric`, `component:outlet_temperature`.

**Site variables:** site:outdoor_temperature [°C], site:wind_speed [m/s], site:direct_normal_radiation [W/m²], site:diffuse_horizontal_radiation [W/m²], site:relative_humidity [%]

**Zone state variables:** zone:temperature [°C], zone:humidity_ratio [kg/kg], zone:heating_rate [W], zone:cooling_rate [W], zone:heating_energy [J], zone:cooling_energy [J], zone:infiltration_mass_flow [kg/s], zone:nat_vent_flow [m³/s], zone:nat_vent_mass_flow [kg/s], zone:nat_vent_active [-], zone:internal_gains_convective [W], zone:internal_gains_radiative [W], zone:supply_air_temperature [°C], zone:supply_air_mass_flow [kg/s]

**Zone gain breakdown (all W, positive = heat into zone):** zone:gain_people_sensible, zone:gain_people_latent, zone:gain_lighting, zone:gain_equipment_sensible, zone:gain_equipment_latent, zone:gain_infiltration_sensible, zone:gain_infiltration_latent, zone:gain_ventilation_sensible, zone:gain_ventilation_latent, zone:gain_natural_ventilation_sensible, zone:gain_natural_ventilation_latent, zone:gain_solar, zone:gain_hvac_sensible, zone:gain_hvac_latent

**Zone comfort variables:** zone:mean_radiant_temperature [°C], zone:operative_temperature [°C]

**Zone unmet variables:** zone:unmet_heating [-] (0 or 1), zone:unmet_cooling [-] (0 or 1)

**Surface variables:** surface:inside_temperature [°C], surface:outside_temperature [°C], surface:inside_convection_coefficient [W/(m²·K)], surface:incident_solar [W/m²], surface:transmitted_solar [W], surface:cond_inside [W], surface:convection_inside [W], surface:radiation_inside [W], surface:inside_radiation_coefficient [W/(m²·K)]

**Component variables:** component:outlet_temperature [°C], component:inlet_temperature [°C], component:mass_flow [kg/s], component:outlet_humidity_ratio [kg/kg], component:electric_power [W], component:fuel_power [W], component:thermal_output [W], component:cop_operating [-], component:plr [-], component:rtf [-], component:sensible_load [W], component:latent_load [W], component:total_load [W], component:conduction_loss [W], component:leakage_loss [W], component:pressure_rise [Pa], component:total_efficiency [-], component:effectiveness [-]. Use name_filter to select a specific component: `component:outlet_temperature:MyAHU`.

**Building energy totals:** building:fan_electric [W], building:cooling_electric [W], building:heating_electric [W], building:heating_gas [W], building:pump_electric [W], building:heat_rejection [W], building:humidification [W], building:heat_recovery [W], building:dhw_electric [W], building:dhw_gas [W], building:lighting [W], building:ext_lighting [W], building:equipment [W], building:ext_equipment [W], building:total_electric [W], building:total_gas [W]

**Submeter variables:** submeter:total_electric [W], submeter:total_gas [W], submeter:total [W], submeter:lighting [W], submeter:equipment [W], submeter:heating_gas [W], submeter:cooling_electric [W], submeter:fan_electric [W], submeter:dhw_gas [W]. Use name_filter to select a specific submeter: `submeter:lighting:Decorative`.
